hero.name: hero
hero.title: Fleet Pulse — Trucking Operations on Databricks
hero.subtitle: A medallion lakehouse on Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, with a governed metric-view layer, a Genie agent and an AI/BI dashboard on top. Every figure reconciles to the trip facts.

cards.name: why
cards.label: Why this project is worth a look

cards.title: One source of truth
cards.body: All four metric views read the same trip fact, so revenue, trips and MPG agree across every view and the dashboard.

cards.title: Reconciled, not assumed
cards.body: The dataset's own monthly aggregates disagreed with the facts by {source_revenue_delta} on revenue. Finding that was the point.

cards.title: Governed KPIs
cards.body: Ratios are MEASURE(a) / MEASURE(b) over atomic sums — never an average of an average, which is where MPG silently drifts.

architecture.name: architecture
architecture.label: Dataflow from yearly CSVs to the Genie agent and dashboard
architecture.note: Every metric view reads silver.trip_events — that is why the totals reconcile.

captions.name: section-pipeline
captions.title: The pipeline
captions.body: Yearly CSV batches land in a Unity Catalog volume and become bronze streaming tables, one silver fact and five gold outputs on Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines.

captions.name: section-optimizations
captions.title: Optimizations
captions.body: Eight pipeline choices with measured reasons — clustering, write sizing, data quality gates, and one error that proved the two clustering clauses cannot coexist.

captions.name: section-semantic
captions.title: The semantic layer
captions.body: Four governed metric views own the KPI definitions. Ratios compose from atomic measures, so they re-aggregate correctly at any dimension.

captions.name: section-genie
captions.title: The Genie agent
captions.body: Natural language over the same governed measures, held to account by seven benchmarks with checked SQL ground truth.

captions.name: section-dashboard
captions.title: The dashboard
captions.body: Four KPIs, two trends, two rankings and two tables — with the agent reachable from an Ask Genie button.

captions.name: section-run
captions.title: Run it yourself
captions.body: Regenerate the data, deploy the bundle, recreate the views and open the report. Roughly fifteen minutes on a fresh workspace.
